components.text: The Rune of Augmented Capacity increases the capacity of the Blood Altar by a multiplicative +7.5% per rune. The Augmented Capacity runes apply $(o)after$() the regular Capacity runes.

With Netherite Scrap and Hellforged Parts, you can upgrade a Rune of Augmented Capacity to its augmented form, increasing the capacity of the Blood Altar by a multiplicative +15% per rune. If you change your mind, you can undo the upgrade in the Alchemical Reaction Chamber (ARC).
